name: input-otp
description: A source-owned one-time-passcode input for Dioxus, backed by the owned adico primitive layer.

documentation.compositionNote: Styles adico-primitives::otp_field directly. Upstream shadcn's input-otp wraps the input-otp npm package (one hidden real input plus length simulated 'fake caret' div slots); this crate's own otp_field primitive instead renders each slot as its own real, individually focusable <input maxlength="1"> from the start (task 7.9) -- so InputOTPSlot styles that real input as a bordered box directly, with no fake-caret/data-[active=true] state to reproduce (a real input's own native caret already does that job). Pasting a full code is not redistributed slot-to-slot -- a named, documented primitive limitation (packages/adico-primitives/src/otp_field.rs's own module doc comment), not this facade's own gap.
documentation.accessibility: InputOTP is role="group"; each InputOTPSlot is a real <input inputmode="numeric" maxlength="1" autocomplete="one-time-code"> (packages/adico-primitives/src/otp_field.rs).
documentation.keyboard: Typing a character advances focus to the next slot; Backspace on an empty slot moves focus back and clears the previous slot; ArrowLeft/ArrowRight move focus between slots without editing.
